name: Forbidden Compass
storyline:
We landed on the planet "Bái-214." It bore a striking resemblance to Earth: similar atmosphere, vegetation, temperature, gravity, and soil fertility. There was one more similarity... The ratio of water to land - this planet was covered in water many times more than our home planet, Earth. This did not deter the Coalition, and it decided to terraform the planet for further exploitation.

But over time, we discovered the ruins of an ancient civilization. That was our biggest mistake. Along with the ruins, we unleashed an ancient evil.
summary: A 16 map Partial Conversion based around Eldritch Horror utilizing the BTSX resource pack, and MinichargePlus.
